title: The Ultimate Unemployment Pack
description: This Project is still in development if interested on helping contact me on discord
body: # The Ultimate Unemployment Pack This is a quality-of-“what am I doing with my life” pack, a resource pack designed to ruin your comfort without breaking gameplay. Nothing here is useful or necessary; everything works, it just feels wrong. This pack was created with far too much free time and absolutely no concern for your well-being. ![What is this actually](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/45f8144cedf77d85fefd921a5d78abdaa1189c0b.png) ## 📝 Requirements - **WARNING!** (**EMF** AND **ETF** REQUIRED!) - **RECOMMENDED!** To download our modpack wich has everything necessary. ![Optifine or EMF Required](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7dafcc8593ddd5984ad11b23fd0f4a428630d764.png) [![Optifine Downloads](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b23454781fb5698557a3d1f2dc9f8d6c771a43c6.png)](https://optifine.net/downloads) ## 🐛 How to Report Issues join the discord from our provided link. **Note:**_This mod is still in developement so please dont critisize it too much!_
